reels.title: GitHub Copilot app for Beginners: How to teach Copilot about your codebase

editorial_notes.reasoning: This is a high-utility 'developer_perks' topic. It translates technical agent workflows into a tangible 'apprentice' analogy, offering immediate value to our developer audience while maintaining the required category diversity.
editorial_notes.recommended_hook: What if your code editor had a personal apprentice who already knew every quirk of your specific project?
editorial_notes.suggested_everyday_analogy: Treating the AI like a new junior developer who you are handing a project-specific 'cheat sheet' or manual before they start working.
